class SkillFadeScheduler:
    def __init__(self, phases: int = 5):
        self.phase = 0
        if phases <= 1:
            self.schedule = [1.0]
        else:
            self.schedule = [1.0 - i / (phases - 1) for i in range(phases)]
            self.schedule[-1] = 0.0

    def advance(self):
        if self.phase < len(self.schedule) - 1:
            self.phase += 1

    def current_visibility(self) -> float:
        return self.schedule[self.phase]

    def filter_procedures(self, procedures: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        n = round(len(procedures) * self.current_visibility())
        return procedures[:n]


# Test it:
scheduler = SkillFadeScheduler(5)
procs = ["step1", "step2", "step3", "step4"]
print(scheduler.current_visibility())
print(scheduler.filter_procedures(procs))
scheduler.advance()
scheduler.advance()
print(scheduler.current_visibility())
print(scheduler.filter_procedures(procs))

print(scheduler.current_visibility())
